title_chain.zh_h1: 线性逻辑 linear (Roberto Di Cosmo and Dale Miller)

spot.html_text: The core propositional connectives of linear logic are divided into additive and multiplicative connectives. The classical conjunction and its identity, ⟦M⟧ and ⟦M⟧ , split into the additive ⟦M⟧ (with) and ⟦M⟧ (top) and the multiplicative ⟦M⟧ (tensor) and 1 (one). Similarly, the classical disjunction and its identity, ⟦M⟧ and ⟦M⟧ , split into the additive ⟦M⟧ (oplus) and 0 (zero) and the multiplicative ⟦M⟧ (par) and ⟦M⟧ (bottom). Negation is generally treated in one of two ways in presentations
